name: sinterdb-workspace
description: A document-oriented database, its official Node.js driver, and supporting packages.
author: Killer88967

scripts.all: pnpm clean && pnpm build && pnpm api:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm format && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm format:check
scripts.pack:all: pnpm pack:driver && pnpm pack:protocol && pnpm pack:cli
scripts.release:prepare: pnpm clean:release && pnpm all && pnpm pack:all
scripts.release:github: gh release create v$(node -p "require('./packages/driver/package.json').version") release/*.tgz --title "SinterDB v$(node -p "require('./packages/driver/package.json').version")" --notes-file docs/releases/$(node -p "require('./packages/driver/package.json').version").md
